narrative.overview: Offline-first workspace for IT Del students on 360px phones during network drops. Calm restraint (Energy 1, Rhythm 1, Motion 1) answers what is due next, what opens offline, and what is synced.
keyCharacteristics: Warm Paper & Slate: Light ivory and dark slate passing WCAG 2.2 AA (44 pairings).
Editorial-Technical Type: Source Serif 4 headings, Inter body, tabular ui-monospace.
Vector-Only Shell: 24x24 SVG icons (1.75-2px stroke), zero decorative shell images.
Honest Offline States: Available offline, Following, Queued, Synced stay distinct.
One-Thumb Ergonomics: 44px tap targets from 360px bottom bar to 1280px sidebar.

rules.name: The Icon-Plus-Text Status Rule
rules.body: Never signal status by color alone; pair an SVG icon with text.

rules.name: The Subject-Not-Urgency Rule
rules.body: Course accents mark subjects only; urgency uses Ochre or Crimson.

rules.name: The Restrained Gold Rule
rules.body: Academic Gold stays under 5% of any viewport, never on buttons or cards.

rules.name: The Zero-Em-Dash Rule
rules.body: Never use em or en dashes in UI copy; use periods, commas, colons, or hyphens.

rules.name: The Tabular Data Rule
rules.body: Apply font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums to dates, NIMs, byte sizes, and counts.

rules.name: The One-Thumb Mobile Rule
rules.body: Below 480px, primary CTAs span 100%; targets stay >= 44x44px (8px gap).

rules.name: The Calm Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep static panels matte with 1px --color-border hairlines; no heavy shadows, glows, or blur.

dos: Do pair every status color with an SVG icon and text.
Do show Available offline only after IndexedDB save, separate from Synced.
Do disable motion under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.
donts: Don't add gradients, blur stacks, grids, emojis, or stock art.
Don't auto-download PDFs when Data saver is ON or fake bytes.
Don't hardcode fake announcements or fabricated metrics.
Don't use course accents for urgency or nest cards.
Don't hide focus outlines or remove buttons from tab order.
